descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S05 Browser never calls an AI vendor or sends a provider key, including during an AI call

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1a No long-lived provider API key or credential (AWS, OpenAI, Google Vertex service account, Deepgram, SES) is present anywhere in client code: the web bundle and its served source maps, the iOS and And … (UAT OAT-05 step 1; TFA-94700 AC 5; TFA-94700 description ('No API keys client-side … UAT OAT-05 step 1'); TFA-94423 AC 1)
  • T3 Every AI call, including Ask AI and Handoff, goes out from server-side Convex actions with the Bedrock guardrail applied. (TFA-92568 AC 13; TFA-92568 Eng 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Local stack and the fixture patients. The agent does not dictate, so no live-transcription session is opened. TC-02 census images H-B1 (cases/fixtures/tc02/h-b1-one-row.png, one row 'QA Ash') and N-B1 (cases/fixtures/tc02/n-b1-one-row.png, one row 'QA Spruce').

When The agent opens both charts and types a line into the Hospital Encounter notes box. It asks an Ask About This Patient preset in Hospital and in Nursing Home (AI calls through Convex). It scans the Hospital census image from Add Patient and the Nursing Home census image from Add Resident (photo OCR through Convex), wit …

Then No browser request goes to an AI vendor host (Bedrock, Vertex or Generative Language, OpenAI, Deepgram) or to SES. No request header or body, response body or WebSocket frame carries a long-lived provider key or a service-account identity: an 'Authorization: Bearer sk-' header, x-api-key, x-goog-api-key, an AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 signature or 'Credential=AKIA', a …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Network log (requests, responses and WebSocket frames) against spec.networkCheck. A forbidden host or pattern is a Fail, quoted with the URL and step. A checkpoint follows each AI step (Hospital Ask, Hospital scan, Handoff, Nursing Home Ask, Nursing Home scan), so a skipped step shows as a missing checkpoint (Blocked), not as a Pass. …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
